hooks.text: 把圣武士、术士、游侠等经典D&D职业压缩成可随时开局的快速冒险
hooks.excerpt: From recognizable settings and classic D&D classes – like paladin, sorcerer, ranger, fighter, bard, and rogue – to fiery explosions and divine healing, Battlemarked delivers quick, pick-up-and-play action for players of every level.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 卡牌能力驱动回合战斗，每次抽牌都要重新组合技能并调整控场策略
hooks.excerpt: Use unique card abilities and adapt your approach in turn-based battles that reward strategic planning – combine abilities, control the battlefield, and adjust your tactics with every draw to overcome ever-changing challenges.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 最多四人协作布置陷阱和联动技能，单人时则独自指挥整支英雄小队
hooks.excerpt: Up to 4 players can tackle adventures together – coordinating moves, setting traps, and combining abilities for maximum impact. Teamwork isn’t optional – it’s your most powerful weapon. Prefer to go alone? You can also command your party of multiple heroes in single player mode.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 元素反应的特效也做的很好看。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: the game is still too easy overall.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: encounters are often very repetitive (especially in dungeons)
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 角色创建仅是预设角色换色。

excerpts.excerpt: Character "creation" is nothing more than recolor of the premade cookie cutter toons.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 卡牌战斗系统过于简单。

excerpts.excerpt: The card-based combat system is nice but far too simplistic
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 单人模式只有主角色获得经验。

excerpts.excerpt: 单人游戏队伍里只有第一个选择的角色能够获得经验
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 随机骰子结果令人极度不满。

excerpts.excerpt: The RNG they made is ABSOLUTE C.R.A.P.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 支线技能检定几乎没有意义。

excerpts.excerpt: the importance of side events (like skill tests) is practically nonexistent.
